items.title: [ECG] KPMG Insight Programme from 8 to 9 Dec
items.author: Klyne Mary Ann
items.description:
Calling all JC Students,
Two days of industry
insights – You’re invited to experience what it’s like to work in a
Professional Services Industry.
Dates: 8 and 9
December
Time: 9.30am – 5pm
RSVP:
KPMG’s
Insights Programme
Over the two days
of career bootcamp, you’ll get to learn from seniors that were once in
your shoes, discover new career pathways and even make connections with
people from different backgrounds!
Explore possibilities
Build your network
Experience the work
Learn
about pathways in audit, tax and advisory through gamified activities
Interact
with KPMG professionals and hear about their journeys
Work
through realistic business scenarios faced by companies today
See what’s
possible after graduation. Discover new internship and career paths, make
meaningful connections and get a head start on your future.
Slots are limited
and invitations will be sent on a rolling basis. Register early to secure
your spot, by 24 Nov
.
RSVP
by 24 Nov, 12pm to secure your slot. See you there!
Warm
Regards,
KPMG Talent Acquisition

items.title: [SL] Project Übermensch
items.author: Tan Sok Kim
items.description:
We are Project Übermensch, a group of students from Hwa Chong Institution working with Touch Silent Club, to enrich our beneficiaries' lives with exercise in inclusive spaces!
We will be holding a chill art session on 21 November Saturday, and are looking for volunteers to accompany our beneficiaries in making origami, and making figures with air-dry clay! :)
A Complimentary lunch will also be provided for volunteers!
Date and time: 21 November (Saturday), 12-6pm
Venue: Enabling Village (Bukit Merah)
CIP hours: 6 hours
SIGN UP NOW:
https://forms.gle/XFWf1EwYVv4yQfjR6
More details will be sent out via WhatsApp.
Thank you and we hope to serve the participants of our project, together with you!
